name: plugin-value-lab
description: Compare plugin runs, locate failures and retest repairs under matched conditions.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose plugin failures and plan matched retests.
interface.longDescription: Help plugin authors locate failed or unknown outcomes and prepare matched retests. Work locally without registration or public scoring. The registry is a provisional evidence ledger; research and team extensions require explicit opt-in.
